prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: landscape social sharing card for the finished Omar Top Deals flyer-inspired storefront, 1200x630 style
Primary request: Create one polished digital handbill that feels like Omar's current colorful African and Caribbean event flyer evolved into a premium modern storefront announcement.
Input images: Image 1 is the visual-language reference only; Images 2 and 3 are owner-supplied merchandise and pop-up context references.
Scene/backdrop: deep charcoal night market, glowing African sunset disc, layered warm paper, subtle kente-inspired geometric borders, market canopy silhouettes.
Subject: an abundant, carefully composed table of colorful bucket hats, cultural apparel, woven décor and pop-up finds; no identifiable individual is the main subject.
Style/medium: premium editorial collage mixed with screen-print poster texture and sophisticated retail campaign art.
Composition/framing: landscape; merchandise fills lower half, sunset and headline occupy upper half; bold clear hierarchy with safe margins for social unfurls.
Lighting/mood: golden-hour orange, ember red, rich teal, warm gold, celebratory and confident.
Text (verbatim): "OMAR TOP DEALS" and "GOOD FINDS. RIGHT ON TIME."
Constraints: both text lines must be exactly spelled and fully legible; no prices; no event dates; no phone numbers; no email addresses; no QR codes; no social handles; no fake logos; do not copy tiny text from the reference flyer; do not reproduce sports-team or fraternity trademarks; make merchandise generic but richly patterned.
Avoid: gibberish, extra words, floating objects, warped hats, duplicated products, corporate stock-photo look, flat minimal design, watermark.

output.text_review: passed: OMAR TOP DEALS and GOOD FINDS. RIGHT ON TIME. are exact and legible
output.visual_review: passed for social-preview use; no prices, dates, contact data, QR, social handle, or copied tiny flyer text

rights: owner-reference-derived generated demo media; retain with FAMtastic build evidence
limitations: The generated merchandise is illustrative and not Omar's inventory. Provider did not report model identity, invoice cost, or complete timing.
